Rooms.Name: A Mountain Path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a mountain path which ascends a steep mountainside. The trail
curves around the mountain so that you cannot really see what lies ahead. You
do sense great power though coming from the area behind the mountain.

Rooms.Name: A Mountain Path
Rooms.Description: You are on a small path going up the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Mountainside Tombs
Rooms.Description:
There are a few stone heaps here and there, the tombs of those who did not
last the arduous journey up the mountain. Curiously you notice a few uncovered
bodies which don't seem to have died of exhaustion. The path curves east around
the mountain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They look as if their necks have been broken and their flesh, chewed.

You are sure glad that YOU aren't under one of those piles!  Many of the 
tombstones have the same name on them, 'Rognab'.  He must come here a lot.

Rooms.Name: A Blind Curve on the Mountain Path.
Rooms.Description:
This looks like a normal mountain path, but it is NOT! This section of the
path is inhabited by a huge (and of course, man-eating) Cyclops. The path makes
its final ascent to an overlook.

Rooms.Name: Vista
Rooms.Description:
This is a stunning vista overlooking a canyon. There is a sign here that
says: 	BEHOLD -- ELEMENTAL CANYON Fire leaps up from fire pits in the western
part of the canyon. The sky looks funny, and the air seems hazy to the
northwest. Electricity sparks intermittently in the northeast. To the east you
see a strong, magic-looking river flowing through the canyon. Also to the east
you spy a cave entrance leading into the canyon wall. The path descends to the
north to another overlook.

Rooms.Name: The Overlook
Rooms.Description:
You see various elemental servants wandering around the canyon. The noise of
humming coming from the canyon gets louder. The path makes a steep descent into
the canyon here.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Elemental Canyon
Rooms.Description:
You are awed by the sounds and sights of great powers at works here.
Elemental servants bustle back and forth doing the bidding of the elemental
rulers. You see a sort of cross roads to the north, and you can climb up to the
overlook here.

Rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
Rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always a incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon continues north and east.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Gateway
Rooms.Description:
To the west a path dips and winds among some flowing fire pits. To the
northeast a path goes toward the river. Beyond toward the northeast and
northwest are outcrops which rise up from the canyon floor. To the east there
is a cave mouth which leads into the canyon wall. And to the south the path
leads up, away, and out of the canyon. Various pure and cross-breeds of
elemental forms wander the canyon floor, which extends in a wide swath
northwards.

Rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
Rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always a incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends north and west. There is a cave mouth set into
the canyon wall to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
Rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends off to the north, east, and south.

Rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
Rooms.Description:
Various elemental forms wander the floor of the canyon. Some seem to be
going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Floor of the Canyon
Rooms.Description:

going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In
general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends north, south, and west. A path follows a stream
to the east.

Rooms.Description:

going about their business, while others seem to have no business at all. In

about. The canyon floor extends north, east, and south. To the west a garden is

Rooms.Description:

general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends east and south. You can climb a rise in the

Rooms.Description:

general, it is calm, yet there is always an incessant buzz of things going on
about. The canyon floor extends south and west. You can climb a rise in the

Rooms.Name: Dark Cave
Rooms.Description:
You notice a path winding east among some huge boulders. You feel a powerful
source of energy from that direction.

Rooms.Name: Darker Caves
Rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go south and east roughly, its hard to tell exactly when you can't
see where you are going.

Rooms.Name: Darker Caves
Rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go south and west roughly; it's hard to tell exactly when you can't
see where you are going.

Rooms.Name: Darker Caves
Rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go north, south and east roughly; it's hard to tell exactly when you
can't see where you are going.

Rooms.Name: Darker Caves
Rooms.Description:
You can barely see your way even with a light source. The rocks of the cave
are even darker than the darkness. You hear a powerful humming all around you.
Cave paths go north, south and west roughly, it's hard to tell exactly when you
can't see where you are going.

Rooms.Name: Darkest Caves
Rooms.Description:
Your light doesn't even seem to work here. Even magical light sources seem
only to illuminate about a foot ahead of you. You suddenly realize that the
path has descended quite a bit but you didn't notice before because of the
darkness. You sense a great presence a way off to the east.

Rooms.Name: Darkest Caves
Rooms.Description:
Your light doesn't even seem to work here. Even magical light sources seem
only to illuminate about a foot ahead of you. You suddenly realize that the
path has descended quite a bit but you didn't notice before because of the
darkness. You sense a great presence directly to the east.

Rooms.Name: Earth Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This is the abode of the Earth Ruler. He decides about earthquakes,
landslides, and avalanches. The Earth Ruler sits upon a huge marble throne
carved into the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ruler notices your stare, and doesn't like it one bit!  The whole 
earth seems to shake with his emotion.

Rooms.Name: By the River
Rooms.Description:
The water in the river seems to bubble and froth with magic. Though it
splashes playfully on you, it does not seem wet. The path leads north closer to
the water. To the west you see a T-intersection.

Rooms.Name: In the River
Rooms.Description:
To continue you had to walk right in the river. Though you walk along in
water up to your knees, you do not seem to get wet. A bay stretches out to the
north and the river goes south.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
Rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
Rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
Rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
Rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
Rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

Rooms.Name: Elemental Bay
Rooms.Description:
The water is crystal clear here and you can see the bottom of the bay 30
feet below you. Then you realize you are walking on the water itself. Truly
magical water indeed. Though you splash through the bay you do not get wet.

Rooms.Name: Water Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This chamber was magically created here on the floor of the bay. It looks
like it's been here for a long, long time. Though you are 'under water' there
is no difficulty breathing normally, and oddly you do not feel the pressure of
the water above you.

Rooms.Name: A Fiery Pathway
Rooms.Description:
You tread carefully along a path which dips and turns among geysers of fire.
Miniature volcanoes spew lava in rivers. The fire is hot but not altogether
dangerous. The path extends east and south.

Rooms.Name: A Fiery Pathway
Rooms.Description:
You tread carefully along a path which dips and turns among pits of fire and
beds of coals. A garden to the west glows with an everlasting fire.

Rooms.Name: The Burning Gardens
Rooms.Description:
Everywhere around you the landscape is afire; the rocks, the shrubs and even
the air seems to be aflame. Curiously, the magical fire does not seem to
consume its hosts. A path leads east among some fire pits.

Rooms.Name: The Fire Chamber
Rooms.Description:
The fire ruler sits upon a throne made of blue flame. Little flickers of
flame dance to and fro for the entertainment of the ruler.

Rooms.Name: Electric Pathway
Rooms.Description:
The pathway glows and hums because of the electricity pulsing through it. It
seems almost soothing to your weary feet. To the north there is a sunken-in
area. A path leads east also.

Rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
Rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. The electric playground
extends north and east.

Rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
Rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. There is an electric path
heading away south. The playground extends north and west.

Rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
Rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. The playground continues
south and east.

Rooms.Name: The Electric Playground
Rooms.Description:
Though there is a seemingly carefree atmosphere here, you sense that
something much more important takes place near by. The playground is south and
west. Something more important catches your eye to the east.

Rooms.Name: Lightning Causeway
Rooms.Description:
Up a set of stairs carved into the hill you see intermittent flashes of
lightning. A continuous hum also comes from that direction. To the west is the
electric playground.

Rooms.Name: Lightning Chamber
Rooms.Description:
There is some sort of control panel here. Apparently the Lightning Ruler
observes and controls electric forces from here. A set of steps carved into the
hill lead down to a causeway.

Rooms.Name: Mesa West
Rooms.Description:
An electric path starts to the west. The mesa continues to the east. Or you
can climb down to the canyon floor to the south.

Rooms.Name: Mesa East
Rooms.Description:
A path starts to the north. The mesa continues to the west. Or you can climb
down to the canyon floor to the south. To the east you see a fading trail of
hoof prints.

Rooms.Name: Floating in Air
Rooms.Description:
Last you knew, you were walking on the mesa. Abruptly the path dropped from
beneath your feet much to quick for you to recover. Instead of plunging to your
death, you seemingly miss the ground and begin walking on air. The space to the
north and east seems just thin air, but you can walk there. The pathway you
came from is to the south.

Rooms.Name: Floating in Air
Rooms.Description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you. The wind whispering in
your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. To the north a ways you spy a
portal of sorts. To the west is more thin air.

Rooms.Name: Floating in Air
Rooms.Description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you. The wind whispering in
your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. To the east a ways you spy a
portal of sorts. To the south is more thin air.

Rooms.Name: Floating in Air
Rooms.Description:
You look down and see the ground 100 feet below you. The wind whispering in
your ear seems to reassure you that this is fine. There is a portal hanging in
midair here. It is to the east. You can float south or west if you'd like.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Through the portal you see a tunnel.

Rooms.Name: Windy Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A tunnel leads east. To the west you can enter a portal. The wind in this
tunnel is quite fierce, it seems as if it's forced.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Through the portal you see nothing but sky.

Rooms.Name: Air Chamber
Rooms.Description:
Tiny tornadoes come and go and dance along the ground here. At the back of
the chamber you notice a huge throne made of swirling clouds. A tunnel leads
west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although the cloud throne appears solid enough to sit on, I wouldn't try 
it if I were you!

Rooms.Name: Following the Tracks
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself walking along a path which leads towards a very noisy
section behind the canyon. The tracks you are following are becoming more
prominent. You think that maybe these tracks are fresh. Back to the west you
see the path to the canyon. To the east, the path continues.

Rooms.Name: Following the Tracks
Rooms.Description:
You continue to follow the prints intently. So intently, that you run face
first into a large sign. You gently rub your head and wonder how you could have
been so blind. To the south, the path continues over a hill. Back to the west,
the path leads to the canyon.

Rooms.Name: Overlooking the City
Rooms.Description:
You top the hill and gasp at the sight. Before you is the grand walls
surrounding a massive city. Around the front gate you can see minotaur men and
women hurrying inside to avoid the upcoming storm. South will take you to the
gates of the city, and hopefully shelter from the harsh winds that have picked
up.

Rooms.Name: Near the Gates
Rooms.Description:
You stand only a few strides from the gates of the city. The guards standing
there look fierce, but then again so do all minotaurs. Maybe you can outwit
them and get inside. . .

Rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
Rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your
hiking equipment?

Rooms.Name: Along the Southern Path
Rooms.Description:
You are heading along a southern leading path. To the south you can see a
very large mountain. Beyond the mountain lies a vast canyon. Did you bring your

Mobs.Name: mountain climber mountainclimber
Mobs.LongDescription: A mountain climber is making the same trek that you are.
Mobs.Description: He wants to see what's on the other side of the mountain too.

Mobs.Name: cyclops
Mobs.LongDescription: A hungry cyclops snarls at you!
Mobs.Description: He looks like he's about to have dinner. (Maybe it's you?)

Mobs.Name: tiny elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A tiny elemental form wanders about.
Mobs.Description: Rather small for an elemental form, looks like a reject.

Mobs.Name: elemental guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: An elemental guardian of the canyon is here.
Mobs.Description: You can't tell which kind of elemental it is, maybe it's a bit of all of them?

Mobs.Name: small elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A small, rather non-descript elemental is here.
Mobs.Description: The small elemental is a resident of the canyon.

Mobs.Name: medium elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A medium-sized elemental wanders about.
Mobs.Description: The medium elemental is a resident of the canyon.

Mobs.Name: large elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A large elemental stands here.
Mobs.Description: The large elemental is a resident of the canyon.

Mobs.Name: earth elemental ruler
Mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the earth elementals sits here.
Mobs.Description:
It looks as old as the earth itself. It seems to know all the secrets and
knowledge of the Earth. You can't really tell where it begins and the rock 
wall ends.
Mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote rumbles.;%25 emote creates an earthquake somewhere in the world...

Mobs.Name: fire elemental ruler
Mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the fire elementals flickers here.
Mobs.Description: As you look at it, it seems to blend in with the fire in its throne.
Mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote flares up and singes you with blistering heat.;%25 flares up and illuminates the room with the light of a million candles.

Mobs.Name: lightning elemental ruler
Mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the lightning elementals is here.
Mobs.Description:
As you examine it there is a blinding flash of light and a deafening boom! 
You rub your eyes and look and the ruler is there grinning at you.
Mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote explodes in a blinding flash of light!;%25 emote explodes with a deafening boom!

Mobs.Name: water elemental ruler
Mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the water elementals is here.
Mobs.Description:
As you look at it, it changes to mist, which swirls around 
you. Just as you get scared, it reforms in elemental form.
Mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote splashes around. You feel you can almost hear the ocean.;%25 emote transforms into a cloud of mist.

Mobs.Name: water puddle elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A small puddle of water is here.
Mobs.Description: It trickles along the ground and gets your feet wet.

Mobs.Name: fire flame elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A small flickering flame burns on the ground.
Mobs.Description: It smolders along the grass aimlessly.

Mobs.Name: snowflake snow flake elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A frozen snowflake floats in the air.
Mobs.Description: It looks a little blue.

Mobs.Name: pebble rock elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A small rock is lying here on the ground.
Mobs.Description: It seems to be a small living pebble!

Mobs.Name: spark electricity elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A spark of electricity fizzles here.
Mobs.Description: Zipping from place to place at the speed of light is tough work.

Mobs.Name: acid blob elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A blob of acid eats away at the stone aimlessly.
Mobs.Description: The magical blob of acid is a cross between lightning and water.

Mobs.Name: lava beast elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A lava beast spews from place to place.
Mobs.Description: The magical lava beast is a cross between fire and earth.

Mobs.Name: mud monster elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A mud monster slops around.
Mobs.Description: The magical mud monster is a cross between water and earth.

Mobs.Name: mist elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: The air is magically misty here.
Mobs.Description: The magical mist is a cross between water and air.

Mobs.Name: particle elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A sub-atomic particle is too small for you to see.
Mobs.Description: It is the magical manifestation of energy.

Mobs.Name: dust elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A dust cloud blowing by makes you sneeze.
Mobs.Description: The magical dust cloud is a cross between air and earth.

Mobs.Name: eddie eddy elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A small eddy current swirls junk around here.
Mobs.Description: The magical eddy current is a manifestation of an air elemental.

Mobs.Name: blue flame
Mobs.LongDescription: A blue flame burns mysteriously here.
Mobs.Description:
As you look you see what seems to be a face and almost 
a humanoid figure somehow trapped in the fire.

Mobs.Name: magneto
Mobs.LongDescription: The magneto considers zapping you for the heck of it.
Mobs.Description: A humanoid figure seems to be trapped in the field of the magneto.

Mobs.Name: ice bandit
Mobs.LongDescription: The ice bandit strikes cold fear in your heart.
Mobs.Description: You see a humanoid figure encased in ice but still apparently alive.

Mobs.Name: rock monster
Mobs.LongDescription: The Rock Monster considers you in stoney silence.
Mobs.Description: A humanoid figure trapped in stone seems alive.

Mobs.Name: hurricane
Mobs.LongDescription: A hurricane rages across the sky.
Mobs.Description: A humanoid figure is trapped in the rushing wind.

Mobs.Name: magician
Mobs.LongDescription: An elemental magician seeks magical stones for a spell.
Mobs.Description:
The elemental magician has come here in search of the fabled
Stone of Surrender which can be used to render opponents senseless.

Mobs.Name: rainbow warrior cult
Mobs.LongDescription: A warrior of the Rainbow Cult swears his loyalty.
Mobs.Description:
The Rainbow Cult has received special powers 
for it's service to the elemental forces.

Mobs.Name: illusionist
Mobs.LongDescription: The illusionist seeks the aid of the elemental forces.
Mobs.Description: She seeks their aid for a powerful new spell of deception.

Mobs.Name: alchemist
Mobs.LongDescription: An alchemist wanders by in search of magical herbs.
Mobs.Description: Rare herbs are rumoured to grow only in the canyon.

Mobs.Name: baby rainbow dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A baby rainbow dragon plays among the elements here.
Mobs.Description: It's only a baby by dragon standards.

Mobs.Name: imp
Mobs.LongDescription: A little imp runs along being annoying.
Mobs.Description: The little bugger steals stuff and is generally obnoxious.

Mobs.Name: HUGE elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: A HUGE elemental form stands here.
Mobs.Description: HUGE, need I say more?

Mobs.Name: vendor
Mobs.LongDescription: A vendor is willing to sell you elixirs.
Mobs.Description:
This lavender clad warrior smiles and says, 
'I WOULD NOT suggest you attack me...!'
Mobs.ActionScript: %50 say Dont even think about attacking me...

Mobs.Name: air ruler elemental
Mobs.LongDescription: The ruler of the air elementals is here, staring upwards.
Mobs.Description: As you peer at it, you seem to be looking at the sky itself.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%25 state; %25 emote swirls around, making you feel rather dizzy when you 
watch it.

Objects.Name: ring earth
Objects.Description: A dark ring which seems to absorb all the light around it lies here.

Objects.Name: hide stoney
Objects.Description: A hide made of the stone from deep within the earth lies here.

Objects.Name: dagger fiery
Objects.Description: A dagger made of fire crackles mysteriously here.

Objects.Name: cape flame flaming red
Objects.Description: A cape made of ethereal red fiber lies neatly folded on the ground here.

Objects.Name: boots wind
Objects.Description: A pair of boots that look fast standing still are here.

Objects.Name: helmet hurricane
Objects.Description: A helmet that looks like it has weathered many storms has been set here.

Objects.Name: sword lightning bolt
Objects.Description: A lightning bolt fashioned into a sword spits sparks here.

Objects.Name: shield electric
Objects.Description: A shield made entirely of energy buzzes here.

Objects.Name: girth icy
Objects.Description: A girth made of magical ice has been left here.

Objects.Name: cloak waterfall
Objects.Description: A cloak fashioned from a small magical waterfall is here.

Objects.Name: amulet elemental
Objects.Description: An amulet depicting fire, water, lightning, earth, and air lies here.

Objects.Name: bracelet elemental
Objects.Description: A bracelet made of elemental magic lies here.

Objects.Name: armbands platinum bands
Objects.Description: A pair of platinum arm bands, once worn by the Cyclops, lie here.

Objects.Name: legbands platinum bands
Objects.Description: A pair of platinum leg bands, once worn by the Cyclops, lie here.

Objects.Name: wand fire
Objects.Description: A wand lies forgotten on the ground.

Objects.Name: wand ice
Objects.Description: A wand lies forgotten on the ground.

Objects.Name: wand chemistry
Objects.Description: A wand lies forgotten on the ground.

Objects.Name: wand air wind
Objects.ShortDescription: elemental wand of wind and air
Objects.Description: A wand lies forgotten on the ground.

Objects.Name: wand lightning
Objects.Description: A wand lies forgotten on the ground.

Objects.Name: club stone
Objects.Description: A large stone club lies on the ground.

Objects.Name: lode load lodestone loadstone stone
Objects.Description: A dull red rock lies here amid the weeds.

Objects.Name: lava lamp
Objects.Description: A lantern which glows with a red glowing light has been dumped.

Objects.Name: energy scroll
Objects.Description: A scroll of energy replacement lies here.

Objects.Name: water jug
Objects.Description: A large but surprisingly light jug of water stands here.

Objects.Name: dust
Objects.Description: A pile of dust of appearance has gathered here.

Objects.Name: flame lance
Objects.Description: A lance of blue flame burns the ground around it.

Objects.Name: icicle ice
Objects.Description: A glowing icicle dagger lies here amid a patch of frost.

Objects.Name: avalanche
Objects.Description: An avalanche is about to crush you!

Objects.Name: morningstar star morning
Objects.Description: A morning star lies here.

Objects.Name: whip shock
Objects.Description: A whip hums innocently too itself.

Objects.Name: elixir anti
Objects.Description: An elixir has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
